name: Revyl Device Check
tagline: Offers a Revyl cloud device check after Cline pushes a mobile app branch
description: Adds one hook. After Cline runs `git push` or `gh pr create` successfully, it asks Cline to offer once to check the pushed commit on a Revyl cloud iOS or Android device, through the Revyl MCP server's list_apps, list_builds, get_build and start_device_session tools. The plugin starts nothing itself and has no dependencies.

install.notes: Install the Revyl MCP server and sign in, so Cline has the tools the offer names. Start a new task after installing.
